referee_caveats_inferred: Cross-sectional ASHES–ASSEMBLE differences do not uniquely establish time evolution or accretion as the cause.
The MSI formula averages Λ, whose no-segregation baseline is 1, but the simulated no-segregation reference is centered on 0; the required transformation is unexplained.
The Conclusion's 18.6 M_sun average for the most massive prestellar cores conflicts with the discussion's maximum of 18.3 M_sun.
The Conclusion gives 15–37 cores per clump, while the core-statistics table includes a clump with 13.
The imaging text gives an rms upper limit of 1.7 mJy beam−1, while the observing table lists 2.5 for I16060-5146.
Sample table notes attribute effective radius to Source Extractor, while the main text specifies 2D Gaussian fitting.
The mock Band-7 recipe describes flux conversion and cropping, but does not fully specify how the interferometric response and noise are matched.
Dust-only continuum masses in radio-bright evolved clumps need a quantified free-free-contamination assessment.
The most massive reported prestellar candidates remain below the paper's adopted >30 M_sun high-mass threshold.
The relaxation-time argument uses representative initial conditions rather than measured parameters for every cluster.
